[SWS_CM_10302] Checks for a received SOME/IP request message
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213,
RS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_
SOMEIP_00019, RS_SOMEIP_00021, RS_SOMEIP_00008, RS_
SOMEIP_00014
⌈
Upon reception of a SOME/IP request message the following checks shall be con-
ducted:
• Verify that the Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) is set to 0x01.
• Verify that the Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) is larger than 7.
• Use the Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) which is set to either
RE-
QUEST_NO_RETURN
(0x01) or
REQUEST
(0x00) to determine that the received
SOME/IP message is actually a SOME/IP request message.
